text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "This project was launched as part of the celebrations of the 10th anniversary of Groupe E and more than 100 years of activity of its parent company in the energy sector.", "gist": "A project was launched to celebrate Groupe E's 10th anniversary and its parent company's over 100 years in energy."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "10th", "gist": "10th anniversary"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "more than 100 years", "gist": "over 100 years of activity"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Groupe E", "gist": "Groupe E"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Group E distribution network", "gist": "Group E's distribution network"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Since the beginning of 2015, the mobile laboratory has been paying highly successful visits to all the secondary schools in the cantons of Fribourg and Neuchâtel, as well as in the Broye and Pays-d'Enhaut regions in the canton of Vaud, that are connected to the Group E distribution network.", "gist": "Mobile lab visited secondary schools in specified regions connected to Group E's network since early 2015."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "2016 Watt d'Or", "gist": "2016 Watt d'Or award"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Society category", "gist": "Society category of the Watt d'Or award"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The 2016 Watt d'Or in the “Society” category was awarded to Group E in recognition of its action aimed at bringing the fascinating world of energy closer to young adults.", "gist": "Group E won the 2016 Watt d'Or in the Society category for engaging young adults with energy."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "“Energy technologies” category", "gist": "Energy technologies category of the Watt d'Or award"}]}
